title: Beyond Optimal Rates in Stochastic Optimization: Trajectory-Adaptive Stopping Rules
abstract: arXiv:2608.25551v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is typically analyzed at a deterministic horizon chosen before the algorithm is run, even though practical stopping decisions are made adaptively by inspecting the evolving trajectory. This mismatch creates a fundamental certification problem: fixed-time guarantees do not generally remain valid at data-dependent stopping times, while deterministic horizons derived from worst-case bounds can be highly conservative. We address this problem for strongly convex stochastic optimization by constructing fully observable, trajectory-adaptive upper confidence sequences for the squared distance of the last iterate to the optimizer and the suboptimality of a weighted average. These bounds hold simultaneously over time, attain the optimal $1/t$ decay rate up to iterated-logarithmic factors in the worst case, and adapt to the realized stochastic gradients, allowing SGD to stop as soon as a prescribed accuracy is cert

translated_title: 随机优化中超越最优速率：轨迹自适应停止规则
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25551v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随机梯度下降（SGD）通常是在算法运行前确定的固定时间范围进行分析，尽管实际中的停止决策是通过观察演化轨迹自适应做出的。这种不匹配引发了一个基本的认证问题：固定时间保证在数据依赖的停止时间上通常不再有效，而从最坏情况界限推导出的确定性时间范围可能过于保守。我们针对强凸随机优化解决了这一问题，通过构建完全可观测、轨迹自适应的上置信序列，用于最后迭代点到优化器的平方距离以及加权平均的次优性。这些界限同时随时间成立，在最坏情况下达到最优的$1/t$衰减率（直至迭代对数因子），并适应实际实现的随机梯度，使SGD能够在达到指定精度时立即停止并得到认证。
tldr: 本文提出轨迹自适应的停止规则，为SGD在强凸优化中提供可同时验证的上置信序列，实现超越固定时间的最优速率自适应停止。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces trajectory-adaptive stopping rules that provide simultaneously valid upper confidence sequences for SGD in strongly convex optimization, enabling optimal-rate adaptive stopping beyond fixed-time guarantees.
